_curatorNotes: chargeFrames: gcsim subtracts a 14-frame windup when CA is cast from the NormalAttackState (mid-N-string CA). Values recorded here are the raw chargeFrames slice (cold-open CA from idle/swap). Reviewer to decide whether to record post-windup values.

chargeFrames N/E/Q omitted: gcsim's InitAbilSlice(96) leaves ActionAttack/ActionSkill/ActionBurst at the AnimationLength default (96) with no explicit override, so per recipe they are omitted. Comment in gcsim source ('CA -> N1/E/Q') suggests 96 was the intended value for those cancels.
Charged-attack hitmark = 90 (gcsim). The CA fires 5 sequential damage instances 9 frames apart, all with the same ICDGroup; this is one notation 'C' action.

Plunge frames sourced from gcsim's lowPlungeFrames. ActionJump is not explicitly set in lowPlungeFrames (defaults to 66 = AnimationLength) — J omitted per recipe. High plunge variant exists in gcsim but is not represented per recipe.
gcsim restricts plunge to AirborneXianyun-launched only — this is a sim limitation, not an in-game one. In-game any post-jump plunge works.

abilities.name: Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura
abilities.description:
To Yae, such dull tasks as can be accomplished by driving spirits out need not be done personally.
Moves swiftly, leaving a Sesshou Sakura behind.

Sesshou Sakura
Has the following properties:
· Periodically strikes one nearby opponent with lightning, dealing Electro DMG
· When there are other Sesshou Sakura nearby, their level will increase, boosting the DMG dealt by these lightning strikes.

This skill has three charges.
A maximum of 3 Sesshou Sakura can exist simultaneously. The initial level of each Sesshou Sakura is 1, and the initial highest level each sakura can reach is 3. If a new Sesshou Sakura is created too close to an existing one, the existing one will be destroyed.
_curatorNotes: Multi-press placement (Tier B per-character note): Yae has 3 native skill charges. Each cast plants one Sesshou Sakura totem at her current position; max 3 totems exist simultaneously, oldest is popped on the 4th cast (gcsim popOldestKitsune). gcsim uses a SINGLE skillFrames slice for all 3 presses (no per-press differentiation) — recipe-tier-b note about per-press frames 38–46f does not match current gcsim source. Authored as one entry per recipe Tier B Pattern 2 'multi-press placement, identical frames'.

Skill frames N and E omitted: gcsim's InitAbilSlice(37) comment reads 'E -> N1/E', suggesting 37 was the intended cancel value for both ActionAttack and ActionSkill, but neither is explicitly assigned after the init call — per recipe rule, only ActionSwap can use the InitAbilSlice arg (and here ActionSwap=20 is explicit). Reviewer: probable N=37, E=37 if recipe rule is relaxed.
Summon duration: gcsim sets totem lifetime to (900 - skillStart) = 866 frames = 14.43s after spawn. In-game description states 14s; recorded as 14.
Summon spawnsAt = skillStart = 34 (frame at which makeKitsune task fires; this is also when the kitsune detection area is locked to the player's position).

Sesshou Sakura level scaling: each totem's level rises with the count of co-existing totems (sakuraLevelCheck), boosting tick DMG. C2 raises starting level to 2 and max level to 4; C2 also expands kitsuneDetectionRadius from 12.5 to 20. C2/C6 modifiers to the summon tick are NOT authored (no summon-effect constellation-scaling primitive); see constellation notes.

summonTick damage authored at CANONICAL ASSUMPTION sakura level 3 (all 3 totems planted — the standard E E E rotation opener): 170.64% ATK per tick at TALENT LEVEL 10 (gcsim yaemiko_gen.go skill[2][9] = 1.7064; sidecar 'Sesshou Sakura DMG: Level 3' L10 = 170.6%). gcsim resolves the level dynamically from live totem count (kitsune.go:107 lvl = sakuraLevelCheck()-1); the schema has no per-summon-count scaling, so a fresh solo totem (level 1, 109.21% at L10) is overstated until its siblings are planted. Level values at L10 for reference: L1 109.21% / L2 136.51% / L3 170.64% / L4 (C2 only) 213.3%.

summonTick cadence from gcsim kitsune.go: interval = 176 frames = 2.933s (kitsune.go:171); first tick at frame 120 from cast start = 86 frames after spawn (spawnsAt 34) → firstTickDelay 1.433s (kitsune.go:28, tasks queued at 120-skillStart). Tick AttackTag/ICDTag ElementalArt — relevant for downstream reaction modeling.
Each E cast plants an independent totem with its own tick schedule — the per-cast summon bar with its own summonTick markers is the correct rendering.
Particle generation: 1 Electro particle per Sesshou Sakura tick that hits an enemy, ICD 2.5s (gcsim particleICDKey).

[Stellar] No current-patch change to this talent: the Fandom talent page for Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura carries NO `buff` field (unlike her A1/C1/C2/C4/C6 pages), and its Change History still reads 2.5. game8's claimed '+10s Sesshou Sakura duration' is unsupported — the infobox `|duration = 14s`, the Talent Scaling `duration=14s` and the Gameplay Note ('5 strikes over their 14 seconds duration') all read 14s. The infobox's stray `|value5 = 15s` row contradicts its own duration field and is treated as a wiki typo, not evidence. Summon duration left at 14.

abilities.name: Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin
abilities.description:
Legends of "kitsunetsuki," or the manifestation of a kitsune's might, are common in Inazuma's folktales. One that particularly captures the imagination is that of the Sky Kitsune, said to cause lightning to fall down upon the foes of the Grand Narukami Shrine. Summons a lightning strike, dealing AoE Electro DMG.
When she uses this skill, Yae Miko will unseal nearby Sesshou Sakura, destroying their outer forms and transforming them into Tenko Thunderbolts that descend from the skies, dealing AoE Electro DMG. Each Sesshou Sakura destroyed in this way will create one Tenko Thunderbolt.
_curatorNotes: Burst is instant, not persistent — the existing `behavior: 'persistent'` stub from the generator is corrected per recipe. The burst fires an initial AoE strike at frame 100 (burstHitmark) and one Tenko Thunderbolt per existing Sesshou Sakura totem at burstThunderbolt1Hitmark (154) + i*24 frames. All thunderbolts are instant damage instances; no entity persists.
Burst consumes 2 energy on cast (gcsim ConsumeEnergy(2)) — reviewer to confirm whether this is a cost adjustment or post-cast drain; not authored as an effect.
All existing Sesshou Sakura are destroyed by burst (popAllKitsune). The thunderbolt count = totem count at cast time.

passives.name: The Shrine's Sacred Shade
passives.description: When casting Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin, each Sesshou Sakura destroyed resets the cooldown for 1 charge of Yakan Evocation: Sesshou Sakura.
passives.caveat: Not modeled: the extra lightning strike each skill cast fires when three Sesshou Sakura are already out. With a Stellar-Conduct enabler in the party that strike hits harder and counts as Stellar-Conduct DMG.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored. gcsim implementation: a1() calls c.ResetActionCooldown(action.ActionSkill) once per Tenko Thunderbolt fired during burst. The schema has no `cdReset` trigger that fires per-thunderbolt or a 'reset N charges' representation. Reviewer to model — likely needs a new effect type (cdReset already exists on EffectBase) wired to the burst trigger with a per-totem multiplier.

[Stellar] Current-patch A1 addition, from the Fandom talent infobox `buff` field (buffType Revelation, The Shrine's Sacred Shade, fetched 2026-07-29): (a) PERMANENT — with at least 3 Sesshou Sakura nearby at once, casting the skill fires an additional lightning strike for Electro DMG at 40% of ATK; (b) STELLAR-GATED — 'Radiance: Stellar-Conduct' upgrades that strike to 50% of ATK and makes it count as Stellar-Conduct DMG. The CD-reset clause is unchanged.

[Stellar] Neither strike is authored as a damage effect. The '3+ Sesshou Sakura nearby' gate is a live summon-count condition with no schema shape; both strikes are 0U gauge (Fandom Advanced Properties) so they apply no Electro aura and are damage-magnitude only; and the Stellar variant is reaction DMG whose real output carries the base reaction coefficient (1–2 by recorded Cryo/Electro hits), which docs/library/game/stellar-reactions.md rules unmodelable. Caveat only, per the round's rules.

[Stellar] Source discrepancy: the game8 summary claims a 'Radiance form' extra Electro instance at 200% ATK. The Fandom buff text says 40% of ATK base / 50% of ATK under Stellar-Conduct. Wiki wins per Nate's wiki-primary ruling; game8's 200% is not used anywhere.

passives.name: Enlightened Blessing
passives.description: Every point of Elemental Mastery Yae Miko possesses will increase Sesshou Sakura DMG by 0.15%.
_curatorNotes: Scaling buff — value field deleted per recipe. The buff is 'Sesshou Sakura tick DMG +0.15% per EM point', applied as an AttackMod to AttackTagElementalArt only (gcsim a4 → AddAttackMod with `m[DmgP] = c.Stat(EM) * 0.0015`). The current `stat: 'em'` is incorrect — the buff increases DMG dealt by Sesshou Sakura ticks, not EM. Reviewer to: (a) change stat to a Sesshou-Sakura-specific dmgBonus or DmgP target, (b) wire as a scaling expression `value: { type: 'scaling', stat: 'em', ratio: 0.15 }`, (c) restrict the buff to elementalArt damage from Sesshou Sakura ticks only (not other ElementalArt sources).
Inherited manual trigger. Probable trigger: passive (always-on while character is on team). Not rewriting per recipe.

constellations.name: Yakan Offering
constellations.description: Each time Great Secret Art: Tenko Kenshin activates a Tenko Thunderbolt, Yae Miko will restore 8 Elemental Energy for herself.
constellations.caveat: In game these bonuses also come from dealing Stellar-Conduct DMG directly; only a Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct reaction puts them on the timeline.
_curatorNotes: [Stellar] Current-patch C1 addition, from the Fandom constellation infobox `buff` field (buffType Revelation, Yakan Offering, fetched 2026-07-29): 'After Yae Miko triggers a Superconduct or Stellar-Conduct reaction, or deals Stellar-Conduct DMG, nearby party members will gain a 50% Electro DMG and Stellar-Conduct DMG Bonus for 10s. Triggering these reactions again will refresh the duration.' The pre-existing 8-energy-per-Tenko-Thunderbolt clause is unchanged.

[Stellar] PERMANENT, not Stellar-gated: plain Superconduct is listed as a trigger, so no `teamEnablesReaction` condition is authored. Authored as two buff effects sharing one trigger — onReaction with the OR-array ['superConduct','stellarConduct'], source 'self' ('Yae Miko triggers'), target 'team' ('nearby party members'), 10s refresh. Split across two effects because electroDmgBonus and stellarConductDmgBonus are separate Stat keys; in game it is one buff granting both.

[Stellar] The third listed trigger — 'or deals Stellar-Conduct DMG' — has no schema shape (Stellar-Conduct DMG instances are not reaction events and are not authored as effects this round; see the A1 note). Caveated rather than faked.

[Stellar] Source discrepancy: game8 describes this as 'enhanced lightning deals 80% ATK bonus DMG after Superconduct/Stellar-Conduct'. The wiki text is a 50% DMG bonus pair, not an 80% ATK damage add. Wiki wins.

No effect authored for the per-thunderbolt energy clause. gcsim queues `c.AddEnergy('yae-c1', 8)` per Tenko Thunderbolt fired during burst (burst.go: when c.Base.Cons >= 1). Probable schema shape: `type: 'energy'` effect with target: 'self', value: 8, trigger: onCast or per-thunderbolt. Schema currently has no 'per-totem multiplier' trigger; reviewer to decide between authoring as a flat-on-burst-cast (incorrect — it's per-totem) or extending the trigger union.

constellations.name: Fox's Mooncall
constellations.description: Sesshou Sakura start at Level 2 when created, their max level is increased to 4, and their attack range is increased by 60%.
constellations.caveat: Shown at +200 EM, the top tier — that needs all three Sesshou Sakura out at once. With fewer out the bonus is 60, 90 or 120 EM instead.
_curatorNotes: [Stellar] Current-patch C2 addition, from the Fandom constellation infobox `buff` field (buffType Revelation, Fox's Mooncall, fetched 2026-07-29): 'when there are Sesshou Sakura in the field, Yae Miko's and your current active character's Elemental Mastery will also be increased by 60/90/120/200 points, depending on the level of the Sesshou Sakura.' PERMANENT — no Stellar-Conduct wording anywhere on the page, so no `teamEnablesReaction` gate.

[Stellar] Authored at the level-4 tier (200 EM) as the canonical assumption: at C2 a Sesshou Sakura starts at level 2 and rises with the count of co-existing totems, so the standard E E E opener reaches level 4 (see the skill's level-scaling note). There is no per-summon-count BuffValue shape, so the 60/90/120 tiers are stated in the caveat instead. Window = onCast skill + duration 14 (the totem lifetime), durationType refresh so re-planting extends it.
[Stellar] target ['self','active'] mirrors 'Yae Miko's and your current active character's'; when Yae is the on-field character the two collapse onto one bar.

No effect authored for the base C2 clause. Three components: (a) starting level 1 → 2 (gcsim kitsuneTick: lvl += 1 when Cons >= 2), (b) max level 3 → 4 (raises sakuraLevelCheck cap implicitly via the level-scaling damage table), (c) detection radius 12.5 → 20 (yaemiko.go Init). All modify the Sesshou Sakura summon's own damage profile and detection AoE, which are not exposed as schema fields on the parent skill or summon. Reviewer to decide — likely needs a `summons[].damageModifiers` or similar.

Both PERMANENT — no Stellar-Conduct wording on the page, so no `teamEnablesReaction` gate.

[Stellar] Energy authored as `energy` target self amount 8 with procCooldown 5, on the same manual trigger as the sibling Electro buff (both fire off the Sesshou Sakura lightning hit, a summon tick with no dispatchable trigger — see the sibling's note). Burst DMG bonus authored as a passive-trigger self buff, burstDmgBonus 100, since it is unconditional at C4+. The pre-existing 20% Electro effect is untouched.

Inherited manual trigger. Probable trigger: onHit with abilityType: elementalArt restricted to the Sesshou Sakura tick (gcsim wires c4 via a c4cb attack callback attached to the kitsuneTick QueueAttack call, fires once per tick). Target scope: team (all chars get the StatMod). Value 20% and duration 5s are correct. ICD: gcsim has a `done` flag that fires c4 once per kitsuneTick — effectively 1 proc per tick (~2.93s ICD). Reviewer to author the trigger.

constellations.description: The Sesshou Sakura's attacks will ignore 60% of the opponents' DEF.
constellations.caveat: Not modeled: the extra CRIT DMG on Stellar-Conduct DMG, or the Sesshou Sakura DEF ignore.
_curatorNotes: No effect authored. gcsim sets `ai.IgnoreDefPercent = 0.60` on the Sesshou Sakura tick AttackInfo when Cons >= 6. Schema has no `defIgnore` stat or effect type; reviewer to decide representation.

[Stellar] Current-patch C6 addition, from the Fandom constellation infobox `buff` field (buffType Revelation, Forbidden Art: Daisesshou, fetched 2026-07-29): 'The CRIT DMG of Yae Miko's Stellar-Conduct DMG is increased by 200%.' Not authored: no Stat key expresses per-reaction CRIT DMG (the anemoCritDmg/electroCritDmg family is element-scoped, not reaction-scoped), and it is a term inside the Stellar damage formula, which this round caveats rather than models.

[Stellar] Stale-note correction: a `defIgnore` Stat now exists (added for Nicole C6 / Durin C6), so the 'schema has no defIgnore stat' claim above is out of date. Still left unauthored here because the ignore applies only to Sesshou Sakura tick damage, and a self-targeted defIgnore buff would over-apply to every Yae attack; the DEF ignore is caveated instead.
